name: Position Hierarchy
description: The org chart, drawn between SEATS rather than people. Table 5 of the design walkthrough. Manager rollup credit depends on it: the manager's name is nowhere on a deal, so the engine starts at the rep's seat and walks up this table. Seat-to-seat because replacing the person in a manager seat would otherwise mean re-pointing every report. Effective-dated because re-orgs happen, so a March deal rolls up to the manager who held the seat in March. A top seat simply has no row here - that is how the walk knows to stop.
